additional_info.body:
Hello,
a client tried to charge on november 3 between 2
:41:05 PM and 2:56:07 PM CU TIME (15:41:05 - 15:56:07 Italy time) but the charger didn't deliver energy. Also between 08:12:58 AM and 3:33:52 PM CU TIME ( 09:12:58 and 3:33:52 Italy time) all the charges that were started were at 0 kWh, so the charger never delivered any energy.
Can you please check the logs?
Thank you

additional_info.subject: ID0465643-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002450] Check on logs CRM:00263000221
additional_info.body:
Dear
Rosita Abate
,
We are sending this email regarding a problem with your charger:
MP / R9 170002450
which led to the opened ticket:
0465643
.
Problem description:
"
a client tried to charge on november 3 between 2:41:05 PM and 2:56:07 PM CU TIME (15:41:05 - 15:56:07 Italy time) but the charger didn't deliver energy. Also between 08:12:58 AM and 3:33:52 PM CU TIME ( 09:12:58 and 3:33:52 Italy time) all the charges that were started were at 0 kWh, so the charger never delivered any energy.
Can you please check the logs?
Thank you"
The logs have been checked and it was possible to observe:
The charger was unable to authenticate the vehicle due to a communication timeout:
V2G - message timeout V2G09MSGSequence_V2GDINSession_V2GDINContractAuthentication
Resulted in error code: 39.
Network Connectivity Problems:
The charger could not reach backend servers:
connect() to [backend address] failed (101: Network unreachable)
peer closed connection in SSL handshake (104: Connection reset by peer)
no live upstreams while connecting to upstream
Session Ended Unexpectedly:
The charging session was terminated automatically, and no energy was delivered:
{"type":"session_stop","unexpected":true,"error":{"code":39,"msg":"V2G - message timeout V2G09MSGSequence_V2GDINSession_V2GDINContractAuthentication"}}
The logs have been added to the ticket and it will be moved to our expert team.
We really appreciate your help and look forward to getting this sorted out soon!
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
